CustomField.formula: "AED " & IF(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c/1000000)) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c/1000, 1000))), 3) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c, 1000))), 3), IF(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c/1000)) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c, 1000))), 3), TEXT(FLOOR(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c)) ) ) & "." & IF(MOD(ROUND(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c, 2) * 100, 100) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MOD(ROUND(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c, 2) * 100, 100)), TEXT(MOD(ROUND(Unit__r.Cost_AED__c, 2) * 100, 100)) )
